I am currently writing my masters thesis about the connection between
a generalization of the reidemeister-torsion (called $\ell^2$-alexander torsion)
and the [thurston norm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thurston_norm) of 3-manifolds.

Check it out, if you like :)
